Re-cut the NAKA screen .s slices at registered objects (every RegObjTabl/RegObjTable table read from the ROM). Found that the NAKA class system describes itself: the Class tables name every field. Corrected the proven-false 'Screen group 7 / entry length' header in control_menu_screens.s.
Compact per-slice headers. Every object now has an extent, and records carry their texts. Honesty fix: an admission that a line wrap had split (so the census missed it) now sits on one line.

Decoded the IvMesage message catalog (80 records x 14 B, 6 window ids, 59 six-language string tables). Added reader chains (symbol, positional .set name, literal and data word, plus one hop back) for pieces that nothing registers.

Typed 3,197 of 3,234 widget records in 14 C blobs as local naka_cls_<Class>_t structs, using the firmware's own field names. SELF/NAKA_ADDR are kept on 4-byte fields; 685 symbolic values per version that fall off the class layout are now numbers.
Typed 151 class definitions (plus 1 split record) as naka_classdef_t {proc, parent, allsize, selfsize, name, propdata, propname}. The old naka_dispatch_t typing sat 4 bytes off these records.

Evidence headers for style_ui_params.s (ScreenData bytecode; the pointer table is 4 x 19 entries, read by the Scoop routines). Found that DbgStr_NakaProcName_Table is entries 1-45 of the name table in ApFunction slot 0x427.
Decoded and typed the MstStyle browser tree in C: root of 10 groups, 250 styles, 250 variation tables and 1000 titles. The 1,521 objects tile 48,340 B exactly.

Mapped the work-RAM initial image (Boot_InitWorkRAM's two ldir copies, read from each version's ROM). Identified the wallpaper palettes and GetWallPaletteRGB as their reader. Fixed lowercasing of hex digits inside symbol names in comments, and a full --apply run that had been stopping silently.
The C model now accepts any *_t blob struct, so control_menu_header.c's 9 records are typed as their classes.
Unregistered stretches are now cut at every offset the code references, and text pieces that start with a pointer table are described as such.
Typed 12 palettes in the C (DefaultPalette via InitPaletteRGB, plus 11 wallpaper palettes) as uint8_t[256][4].
Typed the IvMesage catalog in the C as msg_record_t[81] {kind, code, header, text} plus the 6 window ids.
--check-classes now prints the record-spacing figures the headers quote (4 of 3340; 1747), so they can be re-derived.

leads:
For lane nakabig (naka_types.h):
- Every NAKA record's first word is a CLASS ID, 0x016S_KKKK: entry KKKK of the Class table in registry slot 0x16S (ClassProc does `srl 16; and 0xFFF`, and `*24`).
- The 24-byte class definitions name every field: proc, parent, allsize, selfsize, name, propdata, propname. There are 292 classes; `python3 scripts/analysis/nakarest_objtab_map.py v10 --classes` prints each one's fields at their offsets.
- naka_dispatch_t is a class definition shifted by 4 bytes: its "header" is the parent id and proc_addr is the NEXT class's procedure. NAKA_TYPE_CONTAINER 0x34 is class TtlScreen, GROUP 0x31 is Box, LABEL 0x2B is Label, 0x2E is Line.
- `nakarest_type_records.py` could type naka_widget_descriptors / tables_1 / tables_2 the same way.

Work-RAM image (all lanes): Boot_InitWorkRAM copies ROM 0xEED8C8.. to RAM 0x3D524 (0x219E B) and 0xEEFA66.. to RAM 0xE35E (0x95B B; in v7 0x931 B to 0xE2C2). `nakarest_refs.py ram_mirror()` maps a ROM range to its RAM copy; RAM-literal readers of that copy are readers of the ROM bytes.

For the ui/uimisc lanes (ui/drawbar_panel_ui.s):
- AcWelcomScreen_RenderBytecode and the op handlers after it are misframed code. The handler offsets are 0, 896, 15, 162, 179, 208, 237, 293, 321, 386, 860, 265, 386.
- 8 of the 11 PsMixer_ControlProcTable targets (e.g. 0xF80B7D, 0xF80B80) are unlabelled entry points inside AudioCtrl_DataBlock_*.
- The 2nd and 3rd Bitmap_QueryProperties3x handlers (0xF7B51E, 0xF7B54B) are unreferenced. The comment there says "(in Table Data ROM)", which is wrong.

sepaout_config.bin (ui/sepaout_config.s): the C blob runs 4 bytes into the ApFunction name table of slot 0x427. Its last word is entry 0, which points at "PartSelLangCheck".

Label cleanup (a sed across lanes, for the integrator): shared/positional_labels.s .set names such as Bitmap_DigitD_0x22/0x8DA/0x11CE/0x11D6/0x11F0, NakaInst_TOTAL_0x34 and StyleGroup_LatinWorld_PairTable_0x2FA could become the semantic names these headers use: WelcomeScript_Steps_A/B, WelcomeScreen_ClearRect, WelcomeScript_OpJumpOffsets, PsMixer_ControlProcTable, WelcomeGlyph_C, StyleBrowser_Groups.
